rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese name for the European robin.

example.english: I saw a robin in the park.
example.traditional: 我喺公園見到一隻知更鳥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 zi1 gang1 niu5

rows.note: Use this specifically when you mean the American robin rather than the European bird.

example.english: I have seen an American robin in the United States.
example.traditional: 我喺美國見過美洲知更鳥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mei5 gwok3 gin3 gwo3 mei5 zau1 zi1 gang1 niu5
